findings.question: How ready is Riverwatch?
findings.claim: Riverwatch Pilot readiness is recorded as delayed due to pending sensor acceptance.
findings.qualification: Readiness status varies by date; the 2026-09-03 register states 'ready', while 2026-09-05 sources state 'delayed'.

findings.question: What does deployment depend on?
findings.claim: Riverwatch deployment depends on the Silt Sensor Batch supplied by Northline Instruments.
findings.qualification: Dependency is explicit in memos; sensor acceptance is pending.

findings.question: When are the sensors expected?
findings.claim: Northline Instruments revised shipping date for Silt Sensor Batch is reported as 2026-09-19.
findings.qualification: Earlier register reported 2026-09-14; both represent plans, not confirmed delivery.

findings.question: Does pending acceptance mean defective?
findings.claim: Pending acceptance does not establish defective components.
findings.qualification: Calibration check is required; no defect rate or count is implied.

evidence.title: Riverwatch dependency review
evidence.text:
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — fictional organization, event, and claims.
Source ID: memo-001
Date: 2026-09-05
Subject: Riverwatch Pilot dependency review

Riverwatch Pilot depends on the Silt Sensor Batch for its planned field deployment.
Readiness is delayed while sensor acceptance remains pending. The 2026-09-03
readiness register still says ready; retain both dated claims for review rather
than silently replacing one with the other.

This review concerns Riverwatch field deployment. It does not say that all work
in the Delta Field Team, Watershed Division, or institute has stopped. A revised
shipping date is evidence of schedule risk, not proof of misconduct or a failed
sensor batch.

evidence.title: Sensor supply and acceptance note
evidence.text:
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — fictional organization, event, and claims.
Source ID: memo-003
Date: 2026-09-04
Subject: Silt Sensor Batch supply and acceptance

Riverwatch Pilot depends on the Silt Sensor Batch. The Silt Sensor Batch is
supplied by Northline Instruments. It requires calibration and acceptance
before field release. Acceptance is pending.

The supplier is external to Cedar Basin Research Institute. This dependency
does not place the supplier within the institute's organizational hierarchy.
Pending acceptance alone is not evidence of a defective component.

evidence.title: Northline revised shipping notice
evidence.text:
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — fictional organization, event, and claims.
Source ID: memo-004
Date: 2026-09-05
Subject: Northline revised shipping notice

Northline Instruments reports a revised expected arrival of 2026-09-19 for the
Silt Sensor Batch. The 2026-09-02 shipping register reports 2026-09-14. Both are
plans; neither source confirms physical delivery.

The later notice may explain the older register's discrepancy. Retain the
dates and source identifiers so a reviewer can reconcile the records. The
source does not establish an institute-wide delay or a supplier fault rate.

evidence.title: Riverwatch readiness register
evidence.text: Riverwatch Pilot readiness is recorded as ready. This entry predates the dependency review and has not been reconciled with later source material.

evidence.title: Silt sensor acceptance register
evidence.text: Silt Sensor Batch acceptance is pending. Field release requires successful calibration; a pending entry does not establish that the sensors are defective.

evidence.title: Northline shipping register
evidence.text: Northline Instruments expected arrival for the Silt Sensor Batch is 2026-09-14. This is a planned date rather than confirmation of receipt.
